pages.text: Every attack has a wind-up. It $(thing)snaps$() up close and $(thing)grabs$(): if it catches you, it holds you for a few seconds. Hit it hard enough while held and it lets go, stunned.
pages.title: Terror of the Bog

pages.text: It $(thing)submerges$() and bursts up under you: watch for the bubbles boiling up. It spits mud, three at a time when angry. At half health it calls Bloodgnats.
$(item)Lethal Proboscis$() and 2 $(item)Bog Eyes$(), always. They make the $(l:gear/weapons)Glasswing Scythe$(/l) and the $(l:gear/armour)Mireweave$(/l) armour.
pages.title: Drops
